name: ElRobot2-S1 (Z-lift SCARA bottle restocker), design params v0.4.3

conventions.frame: x = lateral (right), y = forward toward shelf, z = up. J1 axis is the world z-axis through (0,0). Angles CCW from +x when viewed from above.
conventions.units: SI: metres, kg, N, N*m, rad unless a key ends in _mm / _deg / _g

printer.inserts: ruthex M3 x 5 x 4 brass heat-set (100 on order)

horn_bolt_circle.note: extracted from AM-ARM200 J2/J3/J4 STLs (7 of 8 holes detected)

STS3095_C002_12V.mount_note: AM-ARM200 uses aluminium case; pocket/holes to be verified with caliper before printing

STS3215_C018_12V.shaft: 25T spline OD5.9, output shaft centred on the 24.7 mm width, ~12.5 mm from the horn-side end face (VERIFY)

horn_bolt_pattern.note: extracted from AM-ARM200 J7 jaw STL

unusable_cells_level0.(-0.30, 0.0): 500 mL (needs level pitch 445-447 mm) and 600 mL (472-474 mm) and 1 L (525 mm); 355 mL cans work there as the last pick

fixture.note: One staging tote per level; v1 organises within a level, then the Z lift changes level. Level 0 has the level-1 plate above it (underside z = 0.5197 m at the entrance): 600 mL free lift at the place pose 21.6 mm (lane 1) / 38.5-39.2 mm (lanes 3, 5); 1 L is impossible at level 0 (needs level pitch >= 461 mm lanes 2-5, 486 mm lane 1). Level 1 is open above.

small.note: default; 90 mm pitch, 87 mm free width. 1 L: D<=82 but 8 of 60 Monte Carlo draws touch a divider (needs >= 92 mm clear width or a chamfer)

wide.tote: two D120 pockets (positions by fixture track, inside r 0.17-0.385 m)
wide.status: optional (1.5 L / 2 L stretch); with 600 mL it works only with the deeper back-out and is not recommended (4.8-6.5 mm clearance per side, 15 slots per level)
wide.note_v0_4_1: free width 120.5 mm = 125 - 4.5 mm divider (CAD lane modules 125 mm; v0.4 had 0.122 from a 3 mm divider)

fixture.note_v0_2: default config is 'small'; 'wide' is a level-1 swap for 1.5 L / 2 L.
fixture.shelf_slope_by: tilting the shelf plates; flat lane modules; wedge shims 4-10 deg (fixture track)
fixture.retreat_rule_v1: bay rule: drop into a lane only while slots 0-1 (first 160 mm) of both neighbouring lanes are empty; capacity 21 of 25 slots
fixture.lane_friction_note: simulation: only mu 0.10 at 6 deg flows without toppling; measure the real lane floor (PTFE or UHMW tape) before choosing the shim angle

arm.type: SCARA: J1 yaw, J2 yaw, J3 wrist yaw (aligns gripper closing axis with lane axis), gripper; macro Z-lift on column

stack_above_gripper_body_bottom_m.note: links sit >=0.10 m above bottle tops so they pass over neighbours
stack_above_gripper_body_bottom_m.clearance_rule: L2 cover top (zeta 130 mm, i.e. z_g + 0.130 m) must stay >= 0.015 m below the upper shelf underside; z_g = z_floor + max(H + 0.010, 0.143) m. Measured free lifts at the place pose: see fixture.note
stack_above_gripper_body_bottom_m.note_v0_4_1: design-stage budget values (L2_plate, L1_plate, ...); superseded by arm.cad_levels_zeta_mm, which are the as-built CAD levels

arm.bearing_for_moment: 2x 6806-2RS per cartridge (J1, J2); servo carries torque only via horn bolt circle

J1_pedestal_to_carriage_pattern.holes: 6 x M3 through (plate) / heat-set inserts (pedestal flange)
J1_pedestal_to_carriage_pattern.keepout: x in [-45,45] mm, z in [z_c-105, z_c-5] mm in front of the plate face

mass_kg_as_designed.note: mass_budget_kg is exceeded: L1 side 0.627 (budget 0.485), L2 side 0.303 (0.195)

tip_droop_mm_at_0p385m_2p4kg.cover_not_acting: 36-44 (beam theory); FE: closed box 17-21 times stiffer in torsion

clearances_mm.closest: J1 pedestal top to camera bracket foot

gripper.type: top-down parallel, rack-and-pinion, closing axis along local x; one STS3215

pinion.hub_flange: D24 x 3.5 mm on the floor (screw-head) side, 0.5 mm neck

pad.profile: shallow V, 150 deg included (flank 15 deg), V depth 5.4 mm, 1 mm ribs at 3 mm pitch
pad.reason: V flanks touch cylinders D 57-110 mm at +-8..14 mm off-axis; self-centres within the 40 mm width

gripper.grip_band_height_rule: pad centre ~ 0.55 * bottle height above the shelf floor for H>=0.2 m; ~0.65*H for cans
gripper.closing_axis: along lane axis (+y at lane entrance) so fingers never sit between lateral neighbours
gripper.grip_band_rule: pad band (50 mm tall, centred 112 mm below the gripper-body bottom) always sits just under the bottle shoulder: z_g = z_floor + max(H + 0.010, 0.143); pad band spans z_g-0.137 .. z_g-0.087 above the floor reference. For cans (H<0.145) fingertips stop 3 mm above the floor and the pads grip the lower ~50 mm of the can.
gripper.z_g_rule: z_g = z_floor + max(H + 10 mm, 143 mm); z_c = z_g + 150 mm (J1 horn plane); bottle top is 10 mm below the gripper datum, body bottom 4.3 mm below it -> 5.7 mm clearance

lewis.note: nominal, no stress concentration; root fillet factor Kt~1.5 and printed-PETG allowables to be applied by the gripper track
lewis.face_mm_note: v0.4.1: face 14 mm (rev 4); stresses scaled 1/b from the b = 10 mm values (9.2 / 27.6 MPa); the FE outline check was not re-run at b = 14

upgrade_options.B_pitch_radius_9mm: 46.3 N rated / 139 N stall per finger (m1.5 z12 with +0.3 shift or m1.0 z18; hub flange above the teeth)
upgrade_options.STS3250_servo: 55.6 N rated / 173.7 N stall per finger at r_p 12 mm (rated 1.569 N*m, stall 4.903 N*m)

gripper.interface_to_J3: 46x46 mm square plate (corner radius 6) with 4xM3 on a 36x36 mm square; gripper cover carries a matching 46x46 boss with 4 heat-set inserts
gripper.torque_cap_register_note: about 400 of 1000, ASSUMED scaling, verify in test B2

grip_command_limits_N.note_v0_4_3: friction-clamp commands assume wet mu 0.4; at the desk-research design value 0.3 for printed TPU 95A a 600 mL bottle needs 32 N and a 1 L needs 53 N (above the 41.7 N cap): 1 L needs cast PU/silicone pads or form closure (neck-jaw)

gripper.lewis_note: Lewis form sigma = F_t/(b m Y) (module form); FEM generated outline 1.0-1.1x Lewis; not re-run at b = 14 (scaled 1/b)

z_axis.type: NEMA17 with 24 V power-off brake + T8x4 (2-start) lead screw + MGN12H rail on a 4040 V-slot column with two M6 tie rods

column.tie_rods: 2 x M6 (rear 1225 mm at 7.8 deg, side 1221 mm at 6.0 deg), printed clamps and anchors

motor.brake: 24 V 3.7 W 0.7 N*m catalogue, derated 0.35 N*m (ASSUMED)
motor.supply: 24 V 5 A; 12 V cannot run 40 mm/s (28 mm/s limit)

z_axis.carriage_plate: v6 (rear pad and gussets): 0.41-0.43 mm at the nut
z_axis.z_c_rule: z_c (J1 horn plane) = z_g + 0.15; hover and carry lift 25 mm
z_axis.note: v2: 120 mm quill at the gripper and an X rail; carriage plate keeps an X-slider pattern. Camera hinge raised 38 mm in v0.6.1.

contacts.note_v0_4: friction values are assumptions; measure in A5
contacts.note_v0_4_3: mu_tpu_pet_wet 0.4 stays the value used in the v1 simulation. Published printed-TPU 95A coefficients are dry values against other surfaces (0.2-1.0) and nothing was found for wet PET at 4 C, so the design value 0.3 for printed pads is an inference (dry 0.4-0.5 reduced by wetting), not a measurement; cast PU/silicone pad target 0.4-0.5 is an ASSUMPTION

changelog_v0_2: G1 clamp force per finger = eta*T/(2*r_p) for a pinion between TWO racks (v0.1 used eta*T/r_p, 2x too high): 34.7 N at rated, 104.2 N at stall for r_p=12 mm, eta=0.85.
G2 Lewis stress in module form sigma=F_t/(b*m*Y), Y(z16)=0.296 with F_t=T/(2 r_p); the v0.1 helper multiplied circular pitch by the module-form Y (pi too low).
G3 per-SKU clamp limits revised to what rated torque can deliver; 1.5 L and 2 L need > rated torque (burst-only) unless pitch radius is reduced or the STS3250 is used.
F1 lane pitch 90 mm (87 mm free) cannot hold D>82 mm: added wide lane config (125 mm pitch, 3 lanes) for level 1 and a large-bottle tote insert.
A1 J2 range +-130 deg gives r_min 0.169 m (0.14 m needs 139.0 deg = 2 acos(0.14 / 0.40)); nearest fixture target is 0.219 m so no target is affected.
A2 J3 interface changed from D50 round flange (4xM3 on 36x36 square needs radius 25.5 mm) to a 46x46 mm square plate with the same 4xM3 on 36x36 mm.

A3 datum update from the arm track: L1 floor bottom zeta 145, J1 horn plane zeta 150, L2 max top zeta 119.8 (target 118, limit 131 for the 15 mm shelf rule), J3 servo torque limit <= 1.0 N*m (pin shear).
Z1 T8x8 screw is not self-locking (lead angle 20 deg > friction angle 6-12 deg): add stop/brake or counterweight for unattended use; first-run speed 15 mm/s (critical speed 16-24 mm/s).
changelog_v0_3: L1 lane TARGETS are bottle centres, not the entrance plane: y_target = y_entrance + D/2 + 1.5 mm. With the entrance plane at 0.30 m the outer small lanes sat at r = 382.1 mm (2.9 mm inside r_max 385): too tight.

FIX: entrance plane moved to y = 0.27 m from the J1 axis -> small outer lanes r = 355 mm, wide outer lanes r = 349 mm (>= 29 mm margin). Tote slot y shifted by -0.02 m (y = 0.02, 0.105, 0.19) so the tote no longer reaches the lane module corner.

Fixture slopes by tilting the shelf plates (flat 8.2 mm lane modules): the level-0 ceiling at the entrance is 8.3 mm lower than the flat-plate value and the 600 mL margin fell to 14.7-19.7 mm. FIX: level pitch 0.40 -> 0.42 m (floors 0.10 / 0.52 m), carriage range 0.37-1.00 m (stroke 0.63 m, rail >= 700 mm): 600 mL margin becomes about 35-38 mm and 2 L at level 1 still fits (z_c 0.995 m).
status_note: v0.4 = values after fixture v1.1, Z module v0.6.1, gripper rev 4, arm as built in CAD, master assembly checks and the MuJoCo rerun on fixture v1.1. Nothing is built or measured; items marked ASSUMED need a caliper, scale or bench test. v0.4.3 (2026-10-02): glass and returnable containers removed from the plan by user decision; store survey, scale weigh-in and tilt-friction test are not available, so rack, container and friction values come from desk research (cooler_envelope_evidence.csv, grades A-D) and carry worst-case margins. New: reference_rack, eoat_concepts, friction_design, s2.
